SCENE 02 — SOMEWHERE ELSE
Tomorrow morning, you'll wake up under a different sky. Friday night, one bag open on the bed. You haven't left yet, but your mind is already there.

So we picked ten pieces for a short trip. A bag that keeps your hands free on streets you've never walked, a layer for the plane and the cool morning air, a cap to pull down under the sun, and a cleanser small enough for the pouch.
